description_en: Kṛṣṇa Mandira rests on a five-stepped plinth in front of the Svatha Narayaṇa temple and represents a mixture ofśikharaand domed temple styles. It was established by Kīrtisiṃha Malla the son of Siddhinarasiṃha Malla.  A flight of stone steps lead from the east to the main entrance. Two false doors can be found to the north and the west, while the southern wall carries an inscription instead. The sanctum is surrounded by 20 octagonal stone columns. The statues of Kṛṣṇa and Rādhā in the sanctum appear to be relatively new. Two stone lions and two stone Garuḍas guard the temple.The first floor can be accessed via a small opening in the ceiling of the southern colonnaded area. This leads to the open terrace on the first floor. There is a small room with a domed roof directly above the main sanctum. The upper floor and the dome are lime-plastered, whereas the ground floor is made entirely of stone. The pinnacle is finished withsurkhiplaster.A small shrine of Gaṇeśa sits on a raised platform attached to the second plinth of the temple. The shrine has a brass roof and its entrance is guarded by two mouse statues, the vehicle of Gaṇeśa.The temple may have collapsed in the 1934 earthquake and subsequently rebuilt in the present style.
description_ne: सिद्धिनरसिंह मल्लको मठ्याहा छोरा कीर्तिसिंहले यो मन्दिर बनाएका थिए । मन्दिरको दक्षिणपट्टिको भित्तामा शिलापत्र रहेको छ । तर शिलापत्र पूर्णरूपले नष्ट भइसकेकोले मिति थाहा हुन सकेन । मन्दिर उक्लिने सिंढीमा मन्दिरको सुरक्षार्थ दायाँबायाँ सिंह र गरुड राखिएका छन् । गरुड आधा पंक्षी र आधा मानव रूपमा छ । पूर्व फर्केका गरुडले दाँया घुँडाले टेकी दुईहात अञ्जली मुद्रा धारण गरेका छन् । कान तथा घाँटीमा सर्पाभूषण धारण गरेका छन् ।गर्भगृहको चारैतिर ढोका बनाइएका छन् । ती ढोकाहरूको माथि ढुंगाकै तोरण राखिएका छन् । तोरणको मध्य भागमा दुवै हातले कलश समातेका गरुड राखी दायाँ-बायाँ विद्याधर राखिएका छन् ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)

historical_events.event_description: According to local information, a procession began from this temple during Siddhinarasiṃha Malla's time.
The temple collapsed in the 1934 earthquake and twas later rebuilt with a dome roof.
